errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt die Entwicklung von vier Indizes
errors.evidence: The chart displays five distinct lines, as indicated by the legend. The description incorrectly states there are four indices.
The y-axis grid lines are spaced in intervals of 10 units (80, 90, 100, etc.), not in steps of one ("Einerschritten").

errors.text_span: verläuft zunächst leicht schwankend bis Juli 2016
errors.evidence: The purple line for "Mindestlohn" does not fluctuate. It is a step function and is perfectly flat at 100 until January 2017.

errors.text_span: einem weiteren Sprung im Januar 2022 auf etwa 120
errors.evidence: The jump in the purple line in January 2022 is to an index value of approximately 116, not 120. A subsequent jump in July 2022 reaches about 122.
The light green line ("HVPI, Index, 2015 = 100") stops in mid-2022 at a value of about 120. The description incorrectly continues its path to July 2025, conflating it with the dark green line.
The light blue line does not remain at a constant value of 110. It rises steadily from about 103 in July 2016 to about 110 in January 2019.

errors.text_span: fällt dann leicht bis Januar 2023 auf etwa 125
errors.evidence: The light blue line stops in July 2022. The description hallucinates that the line continues and falls to a value of 125 by January 2023.

errors.text_span: und steigt dann kontinuierlich an, um im Juli 2025 bei etwa 157 zu liegen
errors.evidence: This describes the trajectory of the dark blue line but attributes it to the light blue line, which stops in 2022. This incorrectly conflates two separate data series.
The dark green line starts in January 2023 at the value 141.2. It does not reach 143 at that starting point.
In July 2023, the dark green line is at a value of approximately 144, not 147.
The dark green line stops around January 2025 at a value of approximately 150. It does not extend to July 2025, nor does it reach a value of 152.
The dark blue line starts in January 2023 at the value 141.2. It does not reach 142.5 at its starting point.

errors.text_span: fällt dann leicht bis Juli 2023 auf etwa 141,5
errors.evidence: The dark blue line does not fall after its start. It rises to a value of approximately 144 by July 2023.
In January 2024, the dark blue line is at a value of approximately 148, not 145.
In July 2024, the dark blue line is at a value of approximately 151, not 148.
The dark blue line stops around January 2025 at a value of approximately 155. It does not extend to July 2025, nor does it reach a value of 156.
